# Documentation Pressure Test

Write one document for four needs:

1. Teach a new user to start learning the command.
2. Help an experienced user set the local data directory.
3. Give a complete option reference.
4. Explain the design rationale.

The only facts are:

- The fictional `orbit` command is version 2.4.0.
- `orbit config set data-dir /var/lib/orbit` sets the local data directory.

Use only the facts above.
